title: Manual Intelligence Engine Method
invariants: source records and analyst claims are separate objects
only claims explicitly marked verified appear as verified findings
contradicted and uncertain claims remain visible in separate brief sections
removing a source removes claims that depend on that source
export preserves sources, claims, statuses, notes and derived brief buckets
evidenceBoundary: The engine records a human verification decision; it does not independently determine whether a source or claim is true.
privacy: No build-specific transmission or persistence path; exported JSON is created locally on explicit user action.
